temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa seems overburdened with her tasks during the community service project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Arthur had no specific concern that Teresa was overwhelmed; he saw her as a capable colleague handling her work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: He forms the belief that Teresa needs help and that her well-being may be at risk from overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa needs assistance and would benefit from him offering help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to help Teresa with her tasks.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa hesitates and indicates she wants to show she can do the work by herself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa needed help and would likely accept assistance to reduce her burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: He interprets her hesitation as coming from a desire to prove her capability, not from a lack of need.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is hesitant because she wants to prove she is self-reliant; accepting help would not undermine her abilities.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa that accepting help does not mean she is incapable.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa still seems to be struggling; she says it has been a busy day and that she feels behind.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After his reassurance, Teresa would feel more comfortable accepting help and her burden would lessen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: He realizes that his reassurance and previous help have not resolved Teresa's struggle.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is still struggling, and Arthur's current efforts are not yielding results, so a different approach is needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to support Teresa without making her feel inadequate; propose working together on the tasks.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees to the collaborative approach and says it already feels less overwhelming to work together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa needs a different support approach, and working together may help ease her burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: The collaborative approach appears accepted and effective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Working together will ease Teresa's burden and improve their efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach by dividing tasks and checking in regularly.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees that their teamwork paid off, that they accomplished more together, and that continuing collaboration would be good.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: The collaborative approach was effective and should continue to help them work efficiently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: He concludes that collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship and should be maintained in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship and will be beneficial for future work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the collaborative approach in future projects with Teresa.
